beats.say: Why do people fly to Shantou... for beef?
Because beef hotpot here isn't dinner. It's a sport!
The beef is cut fresh the same day. Never frozen.
Every cut has its own name.
Its own spot on the cow.
Some get ten seconds in the broth. That's it!
Leave it in longer, and the whole table judges you.
Then the beef balls. Pounded by hand, till they bounce!
One bite... and you get it.
Save this for your China trip.
Trust me. You'd fly here too.
